title: Qubits and the Computational Basis
summary: State vector, normalization and the X gate on the Bloch sphere.
objectives: Apply a Pauli X gate to take a qubit from |0⟩ to |1⟩
Describe the X gate as a half turn about the X axis of the Bloch sphere
mission: Apply a gate to qubit 0 to take it from |0⟩ to |1⟩.
hints: The circuit is already stored in the variable qc. Gates are its methods: qc.gate_name(qubit_index).
The Pauli X gate exchanges |0⟩ and |1⟩, like a classical NOT.
Write qc.x(0) on a new line after the circuit is created. qc.y(0) and qc.rx(pi, 0) also pass, because they differ from X only by a global phase, which cannot be observed.

prediction.question: The X gate rotates the state vector by 180° around the X axis of the Bloch sphere. Starting at the north pole (|0⟩), where does the vector end?
prediction.explanation: A half turn around a horizontal axis exchanges the poles, so X|0⟩ = |1⟩ and X|1⟩ = |0⟩.
